abouthotel.hoteldescription: A blend of luxury & utility, Lakeside Chalet Marriott Executive Apartments provides a lavish stay at a convenient location, with ultra-modern amenities and exquisite apartments.

propertyhighlights.title: Lakeside Chalet Marriott Executive Apartments provides free Wi-Fi and multilingual staff for its guests.
It also provides excellent child-care services, outdoor sports & yoga.
Other facilities include an on-site swimming pool, kitchenette and barbeque.
The guests can avail paid airport transfer, free parking, laundry services for extra convenience.

activities.title: Lakeside Chalet Marriott Executive Apartments feature a jogging trail and facilities for playing tennis and volleyball.
Guests can also enjoy a refreshing dip in the swimming pool.
Fitness enthusiasts can exercise at the well-equipped gymnasium and fitness center.
Powai Lake is a peaceful and scenic location where the guests can spend some lovely time, situated 4 km away.
The guests can also check out the iconic Marine Drive to take a blissful walk alongside the ocean. It is around 30 km away.

abouthotel.howtoreach: The nearest airport to reach Lakeside Chalet Marriott Executive Apartments is Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport which is 6.8 km from the site while Andheri Railway Station is 7.6 km away.
